title: CMake: fix compiler flags for Debug build
description:
Inline conditionals don't work inside a list(APPEND ...)
There might be a way with generator expressions, but this seems
simple enough.

We already test if a compiler flag is valid, so we in general
don't need to test compilers and versions. We only need conditionals
for other things, like not using FORTIFY_SOURCE with a Debug build
(no optimization), or if we're cross-compiling as test_compiler_flag
doesn't seem to be handling that correctly.

notes.body:
I get a warning when building on a virtual Linux machine on a Chromebook. I think this is the first C++ file.
```
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-fstack-clash-protection' [-Wunused-commandh-line-argument]
```

Is that an ARM Chromebook?
Sounds like 
https://gitlab.kitware.com/cmake/cmake/-/issues/21998
Yes, probably this issue. I'm not sure if we should account for this or not.
